Purpose:-

This policy is intended to protect staff from job related injuries and illnesses, preventing accidents and fires; planning for emergencies; identifying and controlling physical, chemical & biological hazards in the workplace; communicating potential hazards to employees; and maintaining a healthy sanitary environment.

Scope:-

This policy covers all employees on rolls of the organization and those on retainer ship agreement.

Objective:-

  • Provides safe and healthy conditions and reduce injuries and illness to the lowest possible level.
  • Assure compliance with local regulations providing for environment and occupational safety and health.
  • Provide information, training and safety measures to staff regarding safety & health hazards.
  • Install and maintain facilities and equipment’s in accordance with recognized and accepted standards to reduce or prevent exposure to hazards.
  • Provide appropriate personal protective equipment to concerned employees.

Responsibility:-Manager

Assigning Responsibilities:-

  • The CMD has the ultimate responsibility for establishing & maintaining health & safety programs and initiatives.
  • Head of Departments are responsible for :-
  • Implementing and reviewing health & safety policies applicable to the department / hospital.
  • Providing necessary facilities & equipment required for a safe work environment in the department and the hospital.
  • Providing training materials, assistance and programs in safe and healthy work practices.
  • Ensuring area under their management is in compliance with the health and safety policies, practices & programs.
  • Establishing & reviewing a system for assessing safety performance.
    • All staff members are responsible for :-
  • Participating in mandatory training programs
  • Safety instructions and rules shall be obeyed.
  • Safety devices installed and equipment provided shall be used.
  • Defective tools and other equipment’s without proper guarding / protection shall not be used.
  • Unsafe conditions or practices shall be reported to the immediate supervisor.
  • All injuries occurring on the job and any illness associated with the job shall be reported promptly and in writing to the Manager. Questions concerning medical treatment of these injuries / illness shall also be addressed to the Manager.
  • All employees entering a designated hazardous, caution, or restricted area are required to use personal protective equipment and adhere to environment, health and safety procedures immediately upon access to the area.
  • All fires, accidental damage to property, hazardous material spills and other emergency occurrence no matter how slight must be reported as per the protocols.
  • All hazardous material shall be disposed off according to prescribed procedures, in compliance with the regulations.
  • Working under the influence of alcohol or illegal drugs is specifically incomplete
  • Failure to comply with environment, health and safety rules regulations may result in disciplinary action up to and dismissal.

Health benefits to staff:-

  • Health Check-Up :- Following categories of staff, are required to undergo an annual health check-up:-

  • Those found to be having significant test results will be extended medical care as par “Medical Benefits Programme” and as per management’s discretions in some cases.
  • Frequency of the health check shall also be defined.
  • Need to mention about the pre-employment medical examination of all employees .
  • Immunization: - Following categories of employees will be immunized for Hepatitis B vaccine.
    • Resident doctors
    • Therapist.
    • Those on probation shall be taken up for immunization programme only after completion of their probation period, once they are confirmed.
    • Responsibility for the immunization programme shall vest with HR manager in coordination with RMO.
    • Record of immunization shall be kept with HR Manager after every session.
  • Medical Benefits Programme: - All staff of hospital will be have Medical Insurance with cost bearing by staff and Hospital which will be applicable if treatment is outside of our hospital. For scope of service available in our hospital No hospital charges will be charged to staff. Staff will born charges of Pharmacy only.

Pre-employment medical examination policy: To ensure that anyone joining the organization should be sound in health so as he/she can carry out safely & effectively the requirements of his/her job.

Scope: The policy covers all new joinees including those on probation (but excluding these on trial for a minimum of 15 days).

Responsibility:- HR Manager

Policy:-

  • Pre- Employment Medical Examination is mandatory for all new recruits joining the hospital.
  • PEME shall take place after the offer of appointment letter has been issued to the recruit.
  • Following is the categorization of tests required against each job title :-
Technical Staff :-
Consultants ,Residents, Therapist & Housekeeping Staff –CBC, Urine R/E, FBS, HbsAg		Non-Technical / Admin Staff :-
CBC,ECG
  • In addition the management reserves the right, at anytime during the course of employment, to request a medical opinion on the state of health of an employee, if it has any reason to believe that the state of health of an employee precludes him from safely delivering patient care or contributing effectively to business goals.
  • All investigations shall be evaluated by a deputed clinician, preferably a physician.
  • Test result and finding of the local examination shall be documented on the specific format.
  • All expenses incurred on PEME shall be borne by the hospital in full.
  • In the event of any employee leaving the organization prior to the completion of 6 months of services, cost of the same shall be deducted from his full & final settlement.
  • No recruit shall be denied employment for being HIV positive.
